changeSet.author: inkomoko
changeSet.comment: Senior checker permission for high-value partial write-offs (amount-gated on approve/reject)
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO m_permission (`grouping`, code, entity_name, action_name, can_maker_checker) VALUES ('transaction_loan', 'PARTIALWRITEOFF_LOAN_SENIOR_CHECKER', 'LOAN', 'PARTIALWRITEOFF_SENIOR_CHECKER', 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE action_name = 'PARTIALWRITEOFF_SENIOR_CHECKER'

changeSet.author: inkomoko

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM c_configuration WHERE name = 'partial-write-off-approval-amount-threshold'

changeSet.comment: Amounts strictly above this value require PARTIALWRITEOFF_LOAN_SENIOR_CHECKER. Disable the row to switch the senior gate off.

column.name: description
column.value: Partial write-off amounts above this value require a senior checker. Disable this row to switch the senior amount gate off.

changeSet.author: inkomoko
changeSet.comment: Grant PARTIALWRITEOFF_LOAN to roles that already have WRITEOFF_LOAN
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO m_role_permission (role_id, permission_id) SELECT DISTINCT rp.role_id, p.id FROM m_role_permission rp JOIN m_permission wo ON wo.id = rp.permission_id AND wo.code = 'WRITEOFF_LOAN' CROSS JOIN m_permission p ON p.code = 'PARTIALWRITEOFF_LOAN' WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM m_role_permission erp WHERE erp.role_id = rp.role_id AND erp.permission_id = p.id )

changeSet.author: inkomoko
changeSet.comment: Grant PARTIALWRITEOFF_LOAN_SENIOR_CHECKER to roles that approve loans at IC level three
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO m_role_permission (role_id, permission_id) SELECT DISTINCT rp.role_id, p.id FROM m_role_permission rp JOIN m_permission ic ON ic.id = rp.permission_id AND ic.code = 'ACCEPT_LOANICREVIEWDECISIONLEVELTHREE' CROSS JOIN m_permission p ON p.code = 'PARTIALWRITEOFF_LOAN_SENIOR_CHECKER' WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM m_role_permission erp WHERE erp.role_id = rp.role_id AND erp.permission_id = p.id )
